text:
Ely Office

Offline-first desktop apps in Rust and GPUI. Files stay in your folders; no account, no cloud service.

Download from office.elygpui.com or the latest release: Windows x64, macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Linux x86 64 (AppImage, deb, rpm, Arch, Nix; Debian 11 and Ubuntu 20.04 or newer). The latest release, 0.1.16, has an installer for each app (macOS .dmg , Windows setup, Linux AppImage, deb, rpm and Arch package), an ElyOffice installer with all of them (macOS .dmg , Windows setup) and an ely-office deb, rpm and Arch package; each app updates on its own. The tree now builds one installer per platform with every app (macOS .pkg ), updated as a set; no release is built that way yet.

 App Does Engine 
 --- --- --- 
 ElyDoc Word processing (DOCX, ODT) LibreOfficeKit 
 ElyTable Spreadsheets (XLSX, ODS, CSV) LibreOfficeKit 
 ElyShow Presentations (PPTX, ODP) LibreOfficeKit, system media 
 ElyPDF PDF reading and editing, OCR, signatures MuPDF, Tesseract 
 ElyMail Mail over IMAP, POP3 and SMTP; follows the system proxy own IMAP and POP3, mail-send, SQLite 
 ElyTree Git client Git 
 ElyMark Markdown pulldown-cmark, RaTeX, mermaid-rs-renderer; MuPDF for PDF export 
 ElyAgent Second release Kigi CLI 

ElyMail signs in to Microsoft with OAuth, to Gmail and iCloud with an app password, and to QQ Mail, 163 and 126 with an authorization code.

 Build

Install Rust with rustup ( rust-toolchain.toml pins the version), then the system packages. Every system also needs Git, Python 3, curl, Node.js 22.18 or newer (the first to run the site's TypeScript tests unflagged) and pnpm ( check.sh and the site use the last two).

- macOS: Xcode (gpui compiles its shaders when the app starts, so the separate Metal toolchain is not needed); then brew install cmake ninja pkg-config openssl make gnu-sed bison flex gettext autoconf automake node pnpm bash for LibreOffice, MuPDF and the checks, run from a shell with Homebrew on its PATH ( build-libreoffice.sh puts Homebrew's GNU make, sed, bison, flex and gettext first; the scripts need bash 5, since macOS's own bash 3.2 exits 0 after a set -u abort). Apple silicon links MuPDF against Homebrew's OpenSSL, found through pkg-config ; Intel uses scripts/build-openssl.sh , as Linux does. The Intel release runs under Rosetta with an x86 64 bash 5 that scripts/build-bash.sh builds into /ely-share/bash-x86 64 .
- Windows: Visual Studio 2022 with the C++ workload (MSVC, a Windows SDK and CMake with Ninja) and clang-cl, from its "C++ Clang tools" component or LLVM in C:\Program Files\LLVM (LibreOffice builds Skia with it); gpui compiles its shaders with the SDK's fxc.exe . Git for Windows supplies bash and curl; run the scripts from its bash. MuPDF links a static OpenSSL from vcpkg in engines/vcpkg : git clone --depth 1 --branch 2026.07.29 engines/vcpkg , then engines/vcpkg/bootstrap-vcpkg.bat -disableMetrics and engines/vcpkg/vcpkg install openssl:x64-windows-static . scripts/build-git.sh fetches MinGit on Windows rather than building Git. LibreOffice builds under Cygwin in C:\cygwin64 ( ELY CYGWIN elsewhere) with autoconf, automake and LibreOffice's GNU make in /opt/lo/bin , as its Windows build guide sets up.
- Linux, one line per family, then pnpm. The engines build inside packaging/linux/container.sh , hence Docker. Ubuntu's own Node.js is too old, so Node.js 22 comes from NodeSource:

 

 scripts/doctor.sh checks each of these for the system it runs on.

 

On Linux, run each script after packaging/linux/container.sh (as in packaging/linux/container.sh scripts/build-mupdf.sh , which is how scripts/ci.sh runs them): an AlmaLinux 8 image that keeps the binaries on glibc 2.28. Cargo runs on the host. On Windows, LibreOffice builds under Cygwin and MuPDF with MSBuild.

Microsoft sign-in in ElyMail needs a client ID at build time: put ELY MICROSOFT CLIENT ID= in cred.txt at the repository root (git ignores it), or set the variable. Without it ElyMail still builds and says Microsoft sign-in is not in this build; scripts/ci.sh refuses to build a release without it.

 Experimental R macros

ElyTable can run local R macros on a selected range, including values, header
formatting and column widths. See docs/r-macros.md for
setup, the small API and its limits. Requires R (Rscript) and a LOK engine
built with patch 0081.

 Release

Pushing a v tag runs .github/workflows/release.yml , four jobs that wait for no other, all on our own machines. Each job first checks the gates and builds nothing if one fails: the release notes hold only New and Fixes, and the release record docs/releases/ .md states how many fixes were not reviewed again and why a release comes less than seven days after the last ( scripts/release-gate.py ); docs/perf/ holds this version's benchmark for the system and its first opens after install (and, on Windows, after reboot), with a reason for each case over 30% slower ( tests/perf/baseline.py ); pr.yml passed on the tagged commit; the host's cargo, and the container's on Linux, is huacnlee/cargo. Self-hosted runners build macOS (arm64, and Intel under Rosetta), Windows x64 and Linux x86 64 (in the AlmaLinux 8 container on an Omarchy host) with scripts/ci.sh ; there is no arm64 release for Linux or Windows. Each job uploads its packages and update manifests; x86 64 Linux alone uploads the source archives. The Linux job also builds ely-office , one deb, rpm and Arch package that holds every app and one copy of the LibreOffice kernel for ElyDoc, ElyTable and ElyShow ( packaging/linux/bundle.sh ). macOS builds are signed and notarized.

 Tests

The test report is docs/qa.md: what proves each of PRD's QA-01 to QA-28 today, and what is missing. docs/test-map.md lists each PRD item's tasks and the tests that cover it. Known limitations are in docs/compatibility.md.

 cargo test --workspace ; the script tests in tests/scripts , listed in its README (the window tests need macOS Accessibility permission; Linux tests run in containers); the benchmarks tests/perf/
